summary: Small sealed gardens car park about 20 m south-east, backed by bush.

best_section.where: Sealed car park with painted bays just south-east of the pin, off the gardens road bend

drivers.seclusion: Car park backs onto bush and gardens; no buildings mapped, only a small gardens hut nearby.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lot with painted bays opens straight off the access road; room for a van.
drivers.traffic: Gardens road passes beside it; visitor traffic by day.
drivers.convention: Public gardens car park; no vans or tents seen, so overnight acceptance is unknown.

flags: Ground around the pin is steep: 9.6% mean grade, 22% max
Slope of the car park itself not measured
Gardens car park may be gated, signed or patrolled at night
Waterway 43 m away; elevation about 52 to 59 m
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the pin; the lot is partly shaded by trees on the west and north-east.
